records.label: spacr.utils.CustomCellClassifier#2
records.source: Models saved before spaCR 1.5.1.8 fixed this head (2026-11-07) clipped negative logits to 0 and always fused 3 channels. They cannot be reused and must be retrained; :func:`spacr.torch_artifacts.load_model_artifact` says so when one is loaded.
records.translation: 在 spaCR 1.5.1.8 修复此头部（2026-11-07）之前保存的模型会将负的 logits 截断为 0，并且始终融合 3 个通道。这些模型无法再使用，必须重新训练；加载此类模型时，:func:`spacr.torch_artifacts.load_model_artifact` 会给出提示。
